{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined navy knit blouse with a relaxed but structured collar, straight fit cut to the waistline, deep midnight blue #000080, soft merino wool blended with silk for subtle drape.
High-waisted charcoal grey tapered trousers, straight leg length hitting just above the ankle bone, matte charcoal grey #36454F, heavy-weight cotton twill with a slight stretch.
A tailored charcoal blazer, single-breasted cut with notched lapels and clean lines, extending to hip level, slate grey #708090, structured wool gabardine.
Low black ankle boots, pointed toe design with a modest block heel, smooth black leather #000000.

This outfit perfectly balances professional polish with autumnal warmth while adhering to the "neat" dress code requested for the office. The dark tonal palette of navy, charcoal, and slate creates a sophisticated, elongating silhouette that transitions seamlessly from morning meetings to afternoon tasks. The natural wool and cotton fabrics ensure comfort throughout the day without sacrificing the refined look required in a professional setting."}
